assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery.
Atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery is coded I25.10.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded CPT 93229.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias and assess for ischemic changes.
The required precertification was not obtained before services were rendered.
SilverBridge Advantage requires all non-emergency diagnostic monitoring services to be pre-approved.
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
The provider may submit a formal appeal within ninety days of the notice.
